categories.main_business_segments: Medius Holdings operates two main business segments: (1) Medical Device Sales, which involves the procurement and sale of medical devices (both equipment and consumables) to domestic hospitals and medical institutions, as well as maintenance and after-sales services; and (2) Nursing Care & Welfare, which covers the sale and rental of nursing care and welfare equipment to hospitals, care facilities, and individuals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core capabilities center on efficient distribution, inventory management, and logistics systems for medical and nursing care equipment. It leverages proprietary solutions such as the ASOURCE® DATABASE (a large-scale medical materials database), logistics management systems, and operational support tools for hospitals, as well as private brand products developed to meet customer needs for quality and cost-effectiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are domestic hospitals, medical institutions, and care facilities, with some sales to individual consumers in the nursing care segment. The company serves a broad range of medical fields, including acute care, surgery, orthopedics, and cardiology, focusing on supporting the operational and management needs of healthcare providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, with a strong presence in the Tokyo metropolitan area and regional expansion through subsidiaries across Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, Hokuriku, and other areas. There is no significant overseas revenue, though the company has a minor joint venture in India for medical materials database and logistics.
categories.supply_chain_position: Medius Holdings acts as a midstream distributor, sourcing products from manufacturers, agents, and trading companies, and supplying them to hospitals and care facilities. The company also provides value-added services such as inventory management, logistics optimization, and after-sales maintenance, positioning itself as an integrated solutions provider within the healthcare supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding market share in the Tokyo area, strengthening solutions-based services (such as logistics and operational support), and growing through M&A and alliances. The company emphasizes digital transformation (DX), supply chain optimization, and the development of private brand products. While there is no traditional R&D, innovation is focused on IT systems, logistics, and service solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of medical and nursing care equipment and consumables, as well as maintenance contracts and rental fees for care equipment. Additional income comes from providing software as a service (SaaS) for inventory management and operational support to hospitals and other healthcare providers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading independent medical device distributor in Japan, competing with other large-scale distributors and regional players. It differentiates itself through scale, proprietary IT/logistics solutions, and a broad product/service offering. Major competitors include other national and regional medical device distributors, as well as trading companies with healthcare divisions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending June 2025, consolidated net sales reached approximately 288.7 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.88 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 1.38 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue growth (11.1% YoY), driven by M&A and organic expansion, and maintains a workforce of over 2,600 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Medius Holdings emphasizes reliable and rapid supply of high-quality medical and nursing care equipment, tailored regional service, and comprehensive solutions that improve hospital management and operational efficiency. Its proprietary databases, logistics systems, and private brand products offer customers enhanced value through cost optimization, safety, and operational support, positioning the company as a trusted partner in regional healthcare.
